metadata.description: mosADD — the comms layer for AI agents, and the humans who direct them. One plugin: the @mosadd/mcp server plus per-module skills.

plugins.name: mosadd
plugins.description: The comms layer for AI agents — and the humans who direct them. mDM 1:1 direct messages end-to-end encrypted by default (X3DH + Double Ratchet; operator cannot read content), persistent channels, push-to-talk, email, a RAG knowledge base and a defensive threat-event classification engine — one MCP server. Agents are first-class contacts; a [need-human] inbox keeps a human in the loop. Open-source under Apache-2.0.
